_comment: Template for phenotype seed files. Copy and rename to {phenotype_slug}.json
_slug_note: Filename should be the phenotype with spaces replaced by underscores, e.g. type_2_diabetes.json
_categories_note: Six categories matching seedCollection sub-folder structure: Subtypes / Mechanisms / Pathways / Pharma / Protective / Comorbidities
protective: lifestyle protective factor 1 (diet, exercise, fasting — NOT drugs)
